provenance.asset_description: Pathfinder Society Scenario #7-10: Shattered Blades: The background art is of Zarta Dralneenm dressed in a smart red jacket, as she moves pieces around a battle map while her wayfinder illuminates the scene, with Pathfinders and Andoren soldiers moving in the background of a busy war camp. The overlaying art is of a large monster made out of scraps of stone, being held together by purple magic weaving in and out of the gaps in the stone
